title: leighia speciosa
intro: Leighia speciosa, commonly known as the sensitive plant, is a species of flowering plant in the family Fabaceae. It is native to the southwestern United States and Mexico, and is known for its ability to fold its leaves when touched. The health benefits of Leighia speciosa include its potential to lower blood pressure and reduce inflammation, due to its therapeutic actions as a vasodilator and anti-inflammatory agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
